admission.justification: A trimmed or differently serialized package could let a judge grade incomplete evidence or send a request whose measured budget describes different bytes.

applicability: Disk evidence and canonical inline objects submitted to native rubric judges.

A local over-budget rejection records the exact request identity and zero invocations.
exclusions: Trimming required evidence merely to meet an advisory token target.
Estimated tokens as actual provider usage or guaranteed provider acceptance.
